newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Micron Electronics cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Micron Electronics cut to neutral.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it lowered its rating on Micron Electronics Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Rodman & Renshaw also lowered its earnings estimate for the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter ending in August to $0.19 a share from $0.21 and its fiscal year 1998 estimate to $1.25 from $1.45.

-- "After discussions with management, we have lost confidence in Micron Electronics' ability to grow its bottom line predictably and at a pace comparable with its peers," Rodman & Renshaw said in a research report. "While we believe the company could grow its revenues at a respectable 35-40 percent over the next two years, we no longer have faith that earnings will grow at a similar or faster rate."
-- Micron, a personal computer company, appears to be suffering the most form the competitive pricing environment that exists in the PC industry, Rodman & Renshaw said
-- Micron shares were down 1-7/8 to 16-1/8 Thursday.
